# `bit_length`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
bit_length(expr)
```

Returns the bit length of string data or number of bits of binary data.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bit_length, example 1
> SELECT bit_length('Spark SQL');
72
```

```sql
-- bit_length, example 2
> SELECT bit_length(x'537061726b2053514c');
72
```
